# Host-defect fixes: offscreen evidence

Offscreen Qt render of the real `Bar` for the Cockpit and Hornero Left presets at 1920x1080, Night and Day, over a stand-in pink/purple gradient (no wallpaper, no host capture). The harness shims the layer-shell windows, so popouts and the frame are not drawn. The 8 meter segments, tabular values and condensed clock are visible; brightness is absent because the harness machine has no backlight (the honest state). Cockpit Clear is not shown: its per-region ink needs wallpaper sampling from a real screen and renders blank offscreen.
